units.source_text: "义满的眼睛，义满的那双眼睛。"

en.t: Yoshimitsu's eyes, those eyes of Yoshimitsu.

units.source_text: 我从门扉跃身户外，向大书院后面跑回去的时候，继续想道：

en.t: As I sprang out through the gate and ran back toward the rear of the Great Study, I went on thinking:

units.source_text: "所有的行动就要在那双眼睛的前面进行。

en.t: "Everything I do is about to take place before those eyes.

units.source_text: 在那双什么也无法看见、已死了的证人的眼睛的前面……"

en.t: Before the eyes of that dead witness, eyes that can no longer see anything..."
